messages:
maria_g: Following the postmortem for the KV eviction incident, we need to capture remediation ownership + concrete testing additions. I sketched a quick action list, want owners and dates. TL;DR: regression suite additions, new promptsets for evals, a focused load test, and a chaos drill.

cheng_z: I can own the regression suite additions. I'll add failing reproducer cases and automate them into the nightly pipeline. Planning two PRs: one for deterministic KV eviction cases, one for latency distribution checks. ETA: next Wednesday.

samir: I will curate the prompt sets for regression/eval — include the edge-cases we saw (long prefix chains, repeated tokens, truncated streams). I also want to add a small quality metric for hallucination rate on the affected flows. Target: this week + a follow-up eval run.

dina_oncall: I'll schedule the load test and a targeted chaos drill. Proposed plan: run k6 stress scenario at 2x normal burst for 30m, then run a chaos job that kills GPU worker nodes one at a time while measuring KV miss ratio and tail latency. Prefer to do the drill in staging on 03/29. +1 on adding the test to the incident runbook.

qa-jen: I'll own the regression gating and make sure CI blocks merges if new regressions appear. Need details from Cheng on test names / how to run locally. Also request that Sam adds clear golden outputs for the promptset eval.

incident-bot: created issue TASK-PLAT-874: "KV eviction regression suite + test automation" assigned to cheng_z.

cheng_z: @qa-jen I'll put test names under tests/kv_eviction/* and add a README with run commands. Quick run: 
```
pytest tests/kv_eviction -k eviction_case -q
```
Also adding a flaky-tolerance flag for nightly runs.

maria_g: Owners summary for clarity: Cheng -> regression suite (TASK-PLAT-874), Samir -> prompt sets & eval metric (EVAL-211), Dina -> load test + chaos drill (TASK-OPS-559), QA-Jen -> CI gating & golden outputs. Can everyone confirm ETA?

samir: Confirmed. Prompt set PR by 03/27, initial eval run by 03/29. Will include example prompts for streaming edge-cases.

cheng_z: Confirmed. Regression PR #1 by 03/26, PR#2 by 03/30. Nightly integration on 04/01.

dina_oncall: Confirmed. Chaos drill scheduled staging 03/29 10:00-11:30 PDT, load test 03/30 02:00-03:00 PDT. I'll post runbook steps in the #eng-oncall channel and attach the checklist.

qa-jen: Confirmed. Will add CI gating rules and a short runbook for local repro by 03/28.

maria_g: Great — I'll own the postmortem follow-up ticket that ties these: PM-FOLLOWUP-4921. I'll add milestones and weekly check-ins until closed. Please add PR links to the ticket as you open them.

samir: Quick note on evals: include both token-level and sequence-level scoring. For promptset examples, I'll include expected completions and a few fuzzy-match thresholds.

cheng_z: Also adding a lightweight smoke test that runs on deploy for 10 requests to validate KV cache warming. Snippet: `curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warm_kv_1"}'`

maria_g: Nice. Action items consolidated into the ticket. If no blockers, I'll mark owners and close out this thread. :thumbsup:

qa-jen: :thumbsup: I'll flag anything flaky and loop in infra if we see resource limits during k6 runs.

incident-bot: linked TASK-PLAT-874 -> PM-FOLLOWUP-4921, EVAL-211, TASK-OPS-559."
